lines.en: Not fully understanding what all of this Death Ball stuff is about, I’m left to just relocate once more and hope I don’t soon become the last remaining member of my family.
I guess losing Molly would kind of suck too. I’d feel mean if I didn’t at least mention her here as well.
I’m feeling good about one thing, though — and it’s that Ami gets to compete against one of the few girls who at least doesn’t seem to have anything against her.
I’m still not really sure how she’s getting along at school without me nowadays. She doesn’t talk much about it.
But based merely on the way I’ve seen the other girls look at her, I don’t think it’s good.
It’s deserved, I guess. She did openly air her feelings for me out in front of literally everyone. And...threaten to dismember them.
But that doesn’t mean I have to be happy about her having a hard time.
I just wish I got to control what is reset and what isn’t. If I could do that, I’d send her back to before she trashed her reputation.
I’d also resurrect her mom and her best friend and have a lot of sex with both of them because I am indecisive and sad.
Anyway, I’m here now. And I’m still not really sure what’s going on.
: How’d that band get up there? Nobody’s supposed to have keys to the roof.
: I think a more pertinent question is why is that band up there?
: That’s Good Kid! They're Noriko's friends. And they provided the soundtrack for last year’s festivities — which the two of you missed when your soul gems became too clouded.
: I guess it makes sense if Noriko has a key to the roof. She seems like the type to have connections like that.
: Sensei! Do the thing!
: What thing? I still don’t understand why you guys wanted me to stand here to begin with.
: Am I playing the game too?
: No! You’re just here to explain it and tell everybody the rules!
: But I don’t know the rules. I wasn’t here last year.
: I believe that is specifically why you were chosen, Sir!
: ‘Tis no normal ball — that bulbous orb of decay. It’s large enough to crush a small city and leaves behind a trail of corpses in its shadowy wake!
: There can be no rules to govern its existence, Sir! You are fighting a losing battle too! Just as we are.
: Sure, Molly. I’m sure that’s just as true as every other delusion of grandeur you’ve hurled at me over the course of our shared existence.
: Uhh...Dad?
: What, Ami?
: You might want to open your eyes for a second.
: What the fuck is that thing?
: ‘Tis fate itself, Sir! Congealed into a single spherical mass that must be defeated by any means necessary!
: Greetings once more, girls of 1-A! Has Senpai explained the rules yet?!
: Not even close!
: Great! Then we’re just about ready to go!
: Imani! I don’t like the way your alligator is staring at me! I do like the way it wears a top hat, though! I feel so conflicted and so tired all at once!
: Rin! Make up for your mother’s fear and inability to identify reptiles by shouting out the trick I taught you to decipher the difference between alligators and crocodiles last year!
: Ooh! I remember this! V is for vcrocodile and Catherine has a V-shaped snout thing!
: Ooooh, that makes a lot of sense.
: Senpai! Would you please do the honors of-
: Wait, where’d he go?
: Aaah! My dad turned into an outline! The death ball’s power is immeasurable!
: No, Ami! He merely escaped! You can trust me! I’ve been reading subtitles my whole life!
: I’m over here. I just want no part of this.
: He’s also right over there! He just wants no part of this!
: Traitor! Defend your daughter from the all-destroying orb!
: And her friend as well! It’s significantly more imposing now that it’s setting in that I won’t be on the sidelines this time!
: Whistle incoming! Cover your ears if your name is Miku!
: I think Miku’s still back at the-
: AAAAH! MY EARS!
: CAN WE NOT INVEST IN A QUIETER WHISTLE?!
: LOOK ALIVE OR DIE GIRLS! THE LAST ONE STANDING IS THE WINNER OF DEATH BALL ROUND 2!
: AND BE CAREFUL! THE DEATH BALL HAS GAINED CONSCIOUS THOUGHT!
: It’s WHAT?!
: It can teleport too?!
: The death ball peers deep into Ami’s mind! It eats away at her soul!
: No! I need my soul!
: And I need to know how Berserk ends! Bye, Ami!
: COWARD!
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!
: That’s right, girls! Flee from the death ball! Survive by any means necessary because we’ve learned by now that even throwing it into the sun won’t kill it!
: Are we sure this is safe?
: No, but I’m pretty sure that’s the point.
: I’m just glad I don’t have to worry about my daughter being killed this time.
: Yeah, but I have to worry about that for mine, so it sort of fucks with what I was thinking earlier about how happy I was she’s going up against Molly.
: On the bright side, if she does die, I’m almost 100%% sure there will be a documentary about it.
: Oh, good. That makes everything better.
: Yeah, well I’ve never been good at cheering people up. Just ask Yuki.
: You talked to her?
: Since when? The near-OD thing that time she busted into the apartment?
: Just...recently.
: Yeah. I drag her to the gym with me sometimes. She ain’t doin’ so hot.
: Yumi’s stopped goin’ to see her too.
: She...has?
: Are we seriously playing this fucking game again? Have we learned absolutely nothing?
: Yeah. Think it’s really weighing on her too.
: Don’t run from it! The death ball can only be defeated by love! Why does no one understand that but me?!
: Yuki says a lot of shit about how bad of a parent she is. And...I’m not really gonna disagree since I can’t even fathom abandoning Rin.
: My competitive spirit is suddenly overflowing. Tag me in, Emerald Guardian. I will throw the ball to a more distant star this time.
: But it’s easy to tell how seriously she regrets what she did. And she does want a relationship with Yumi.
: That sort of thing just...can’t be one sided, though. So Yuki’s either gotta try reaching out to her or just...lie in the bed she made.
: That’s all you’ve heard, though? She hasn’t told you anything else?
: She didn’t even tell me that. I figured it out on my own. Are you impressed?
: ...Akira?
: Hah...hah...hah...Molly...uses...an escape rope! Ten escape ropes! Fly! Surf! Whatever gets me...away from this thing!
: There are...apartments...just outside of the soccer field! We can...take shelter...in one of those!
: You seek to form a truce here at the brink of our deaths?!
: I don’t know any other DM’s! I can’t afford to lose you until the campaign is over!
: Surely I mean more to you than just my abilities?!
: Yeah! Sure! If that’s what makes you happy!
: What’s the strategy then?! Because Tuxedo Mask isn’t going to swoop in and save the day for us here, Ami!
: There’s always a chance he will! I’ll never give up hope! Just distract the ball while I get away!
: Then what will becomes of me once you’ve escaped?!
: I don’t know! Soup, maybe?!
: Irish soup?! When there’s a Japanese alternative right beside me?! YOU distract the ball, Arborea! I will escape instead! My people aren’t known for their soup!
: Wow. Those two are so loud that I can hear them from all the way up here.
: At least it looks like Ami is having fun again...
: What??? Can you speak up, Sana???
: Am I really so quiet that you can hear them but not me?...
: I can’t hear you! You’re going to have to-
: I said it’s good Ami is having fun! I was starting to worry about her!
: Oh, really? I didn’t know you guys were that close. That’s really nice, Sana.
: I just have a lot in common with her. People can get...different when they lose someone.
: Yeah...I’m fortunate enough to not really know what that’s like. I guess I’m glad that Ami’s doing a little better now, though.
: I’m just worried Sensei might be thinking about her a little too much now. Which wouldn’t be that bad if she didn’t want to fuck his brains out.
: I’d probably want to fuck Sensei if he was my dad too...
: Yeah, but you’re a freak. You don’t count.
: You masturbate to ponies.
: That...not...all the time! No kink-shaming on the roof!
: I’m not shaming you. I just think people might be a little too hard on Ami. I think it’s nice to love someone as much as she loves Sensei.
: And the...threatening to dismember anyone who gets close to him thing?
: We all want to do that. She’s just the first one to say it out loud.
: No, Sana. We don’t all want to-
: Uh-oh. I think the death ball is about to explode.
: There’s no way the death ball is about to-
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHH!
: S-S-STAY BACK, DEATH BALL! I...I’M WARNING YOU! I’LL CAST SHADOW WORD: DEATH!
: It has “death” in its name! That obviously won’t do anything but make it stronger, Molly!
: Then...Shadow Word: Pain! Shadow Word: Leave Me Alone & Return to the Sun!
: There is...no way this is how it ends for me...killed by a ball...after all I’ve been through...
: We can still live! There must be a chance! There must be something we can do!
: That’s what I’ve been trying to tell you guys! The death ball is weak to love!
: Shadow Word: Love! Shadow Word: Hug! Shadow Word...Breed?!
: Shadow Word: Tell Us What To Do If You’re So Smart, Uta!
: Kiss!
: What?!
: The death ball knows nothing but hate and destruction! And it’s because of that that we misunderstand what it truly wants!
: To know there is more to life than this! To know that love is real!
: Just have Tsuneyo fuckin’ throw it again.
: Put me in, coach. I’m ready to play.
: Uta — is it possible that, like me, you maybe just want to see as many girls kiss as possible?
: Yes! It’s possible I’m wrong and that the death ball crushes you while you are kissing! But I still think you guys should try!
: It’s coming closer, Arborea!
: I’m not blind, Molly! I can see it!
: I understand that! But having nothing but action shots and zero dialogue in a visual novel would not make for a very exciting game! Or a novel at all for that matter!
: Cool! Kiss me!
: Wait! Really?!
: I refuse to die here! I have so much more I need to do!
: But Sensei’s right there!
: And we both know he’d like it! Which should provide further incentive to proceed if wanting to avoid death is not enough for you!
: Have fun, you two.
: Just to be sure — this isn’t a confession, right?! We’re doing this out of necessity?!
: Does it really matter?!
: It does to the people who tag the game! Sex under the necessity is too niche of a category to just tack on without properly establishing ground rules of what necessity means!
: Who said anything about sex?!
: Oh! Sorry! This is just a lot like a dream I had once! I must have mixed things up!
: Guys! There’s not much time left! You need to act now or-
: Mmnh!
: Mnhmhm!??!
: YES! FINALLY! SOMEBODY DID IT WHEN I TOLD THEM TO!
: I never thought I- wait...did my plan actually work?
: Did...did it stop moving?
: There! Are you happy, death ball?! Is girl-on-girl action what you wanted all along?!
: Y-Yeah! You pervy...little...orb! I bet you liked that, didn’t you?!
: Don’t make it weird.
: Sorry. I’ve never kissed a friend without it ruining everything before.
: Hey, we’re good now. I’m glad to see you’ve moved on to Ami instead.
: Imani, what now? The ball just, like...froze.
: Wait, Rika.
: Wait...
: What...What’s happening?
: I think...
: I think it’s...going home...
: I now understand...
: The meaning of life...
: Has always been lesbians...
: Amen.
: Goodbye, old friend...you’re in a better place now.
: Yeah! So that was weird. But nobody died, so I call that a win.
: The death ball has a 0%% kill rate when it comes to class 1-A. And that’s probably a world record, so you guys should be proud.
: I didn’t get a chance to ask because I was too busy trying not to die and also kissing Molly, but why is there a crocodile here?
: Oh, this is just Catherine. She’s been eating all of the extra arms I ordered and will probably return to the swamp whenever we run out.
: Wow. Last year’s Dorm Wars really were weird, weren’t they?
: Yeah. I was going through it back then. You know how it is, Ami.
: I sure do, Miss Imai. And I imagine I’d be feeding body parts to a crocodile as well if I had access to both of those things.
: So, now that the unholy sphere has been vanquished, what becomes of the competition? And what loot did it drop?
: Just some gold we’re putting toward the next Dorm Wars.
: As far as the competition goes, though, we don’t really have a winner.
: The idea was to give the point to whoever the last girl standing was and you both went down at the same time. And seeing as you’re both still on your feet now-
: Why, yes. It does appear that we have found ourselves in quite the conundrum given our quick thinking and wit.
: But! If I may offer a suggestion, rerunning the D&D scenario from earlier would take virtually no preparation at all given that the characters and plot have already been-
: Ah?!
: MNGH! What?! Whaaaat?! What happened?!
: Uh-oh! Looks like Molly isn’t on her feet anymore! Which means that Ami is the winner!
: A round of applause for Ami, everyone! Congratulations on winning your first contest back from the IL! And you only had to kiss one girl to do it.
: Phbhbhthtt! There’s so much...sand in my mouth now! Is this the thanks I get for lending you my lips?!
: Sorry, Molly. All’s fair in the game of love and death ball.
: You might want to get up soon though, or Imani’s crocodile might eat you.
: Gyaaaah! ‘Tis Rotgrip all over again! Stay back, you fiend!
: Aww...it’s okay, Catherine. She didn’t mean it.
: Here. Have an arm.
: Oh, so you just carry them around? That’s really cool, Miss Imai.
: Thanks, Ami! Here. High five.
: Ooh! Fun!
: Right?! But, as fun as it is, it can’t last forever! Because the time has come-
